recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆明顯增大的原紅血球（giant pronormoblast），核內染色質被推向核膜邊緣，核中為淡紫、細顆粒狀的毛玻璃樣包涵體，周圍有深藍細胞質環；這是微小病毒 B19（parvovirus B19）感染的典型核內包涵體。
features: Single markedly enlarged erythroid precursor (giant pronormoblast) in the center of the field
Nucleus with pale, finely granular/vacuolated glassy intranuclear inclusion and chromatin margination
Rim of amphophilic to basophilic cytoplasm surrounding the enlarged nucleus
Background marrow with mixed hematopoietic cells, scattered eosinophilic precursors, and adipocytes
Golden-brown hemosiderin-laden macrophages scattered in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a mixed hematopoietic background with adipocytes and scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages. In the center there is a markedly enlarged erythroid precursor with a large nucleus containing a pale, glassy, finely granular intranuclear inclusion with peripheral chromatin margination, surrounded by a rim of basophilic cytoplasm. Maturing erythroid precursors are not conspicuous in this field. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection; confirmation by parvovirus immunohistochemistry or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm, whereas the parvovirus-infected pronormoblast has a round nucleus with a glassy intranuclear inclusion and a thin basophilic rim.
CMV produces cytomegaly in endothelial/stromal cells with a single dense owl-eye nuclear inclusion and a halo, often with cytoplasmic inclusions.
Shows sheets of proerythroblasts without viral inclusions and with p53 overexpression/TP53 mutation, rather than scattered giant pronormoblasts with erythroid aplasia.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor cell or Reed-Sternberg-like cell
ddx.vs: These show prominent macronucleoli, cohesive clusters, or appropriate IHC markers rather than a glassy intranuclear inclusion with erythroid (E-cadherin/glycophorin) lineage.
